organization.name: CrossBar, Inc.
organization.summary: Chip company. The NIST validation listing names Crossbar, Inc. (Santa Clara, California) as vendor of the Daric PQC cryptographic library. The crossbar-inc GitHub organization was created 2021-12-30 and holds the Daric hardware, SDK and documentation repositories. The proposal says CrossBar has developed ReRAM since 2008 and the Daric chip since 2021, holds more than 200 patents and works with TSMC and Foxconn. The company website returned a bot check (HTTP 403) and could not be read.

claims.claim: Daric has published RTL, SDK and documentation.
claims.method: GitHub API: all three public repositories exist. daric-hardware (Apache-2.0, created 2026-04-23, last push 2026-08-31, 3 stars), daric-sdk (Apache-2.0, created 2026-04-23, last push 2026-10-13, 15 stars) and daric-doc (created 2026-08-16, sections Daric, EVB, RISCV Development, Download Tool, FAQ). Whether the hardware repository contains complete RTL was not checked.

claims.claim: The post-quantum library (ML-DSA, ML-KEM) is NIST CAVP-validated on the RISC-V core.
claims.method: The NIST CSRC page lists the CrossBar Daric PQC Cryptographic Library, vendor Crossbar, Inc., with ML-DSA KeyGen, SigGen and SigVer and ML-KEM entries for both the Arm Cortex-M7 and RISC-V core operating environments, last updated 9/28/2026.

claims.claim: The shared Ethereum signer runs on Ostros hardware with verifiable signing (ERC-8213), demoed at Devcon 8.
claims.method: The ethereum-app repository exists (Apache-2.0, created 2025-06-25, last push 2026-10-24). A demo on Ostros hardware or ERC-8213 support was not confirmed. Two Devcon 8 session pages exist but their text did not load.

claims.claim: Xous runs on Ostros with a fully open bootloader, e-ink UI and deterministic firmware build.
claims.method: xous-core exists (Apache-2.0, created 2020-03-10, last push 2026-11-22, 1022 stars). Its use on Ostros and the deterministic build were not checked.

claims.claim: The Founders Edition ships to developers in late November 2026 and 196 developers signed up for the Dabao hackathon at Devcon 8.
claims.method: The Ostros page returned a bot check (HTTP 403) and no independent report was found.

claims.claim: In October 2026, Ledger confirmed a hidden implant in a reseller device, with reported losses above USD 86 million.
claims.method: Background claim attributed in the proposal to BleepingComputer and Ledger without links. The cited articles were not located.
